### Distress Signal
Author: Luann Prater
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/encouragement/encouragement-for-today-november-22-2005-1363734.html
Passage: 2 Chronicles 32:20
Points:
- Following God wholeheartedly does not make believers immune to sudden trials or spiritual attacks.
- King Hezekiah and the prophet Isaiah responded to crisis by joining together in unified prayer.
- Their desperate cry to heaven was fueled by unwavering faith in God's power to deliver.
- Believers are urged to break out of isolation and invite trusted prayer partners into their struggles.
- God still hears sincere cries for help and intervenes to fight battles on behalf of His people.
